newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba to spend 10 bln yen to make big LCDs-paper.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba to spend 10 bln yen to make big LCDs-paper.

text.p: Toshiba Corp plans to invest more than 10 billion yen on facilities to begin mass production as early as this autumn of large liquid crystal displays (LCDs), a Toshiba spokeswoman said on Friday morning.
The company will produce a new type of thin film transistor (TFT) LCD that will be up to twice the size of standard LCDs but 10 to 20 percent thinner, she said.
She could not confirm, however, a statement in Thursday's edition of the Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun that the new facilities would cut LCD production costs by 20 percent.
The Toshiba spokeswoman said the new large LCD is made with low-temperature polysilicon instead of the usual amorphous silicon.
The new LCD can process image data quicker than amorphus silicon LCDs, she said.
The size of Toshiba's new LCD will be 27.5 by 19.5 cm, twice the size of the largest low-temperature LCD currently in the market, she said.
